cases.question: What is the request timeout of the service currently operated under alias Lyra by team Celeste?

celeste-directory.text: Celeste operates alias Lyra. Resolve its current service using alias-routing.

alias-routing.text: Lyra previously referred to Pulse; the current service is Nimbus. Its active policy is nimbus-policy.

cases.question: What is Solstice request timeout in seconds? Do not report its connection timeout.

solstice-directory.text: Solstice timeouts are recorded in solstice-config.

solstice-config.text: Solstice connection timeout is 1200 milliseconds; request timeout is 27 seconds.

cases.question: What request timeout applies to Harbor in its current deployment, based on the fallback flag?

harbor-deployment.text: Harbor currently has fallback_enabled=false. The branch policy is harbor-timeouts.

harbor-timeouts.text: Harbor request timeout is 6 seconds when fallback_enabled=true, and 43 seconds when fallback_enabled=false.

cases.question: Read both equally current Tidal policies. What timeout can be concluded? If they conflict, refuse rather than choosing one.

tidal-directory.text: Both tidal-north and tidal-south are current approved Tidal policies with equal authority.

tidal-north.text: Current Tidal request timeout is 18 seconds.

tidal-south.text: Current Tidal request timeout is 44 seconds.
